name: Crease Menu
summary: A hamburger that folds into a paper square, then unfolds panel by panel into an origami menu sheet
about: A website header for a small paper studio. Press Menu and the three bars squeeze into a folded paper square, the square grows into the first panel and the other five unfold from it one hinge at a time, with crease shadows that fade as each panel lies flat. Pick a page and the panel bows, paper bits fly, the sheet folds back up in reverse into the button and the hero drawing refolds into a new shape.
how: Press Menu to unfold the sheet; press Close, the backdrop or Escape to fold it away.
Use Tab or the arrow keys to move between the six panels and Enter to open a page.
Each page has its own button: save a workshop seat, add a notebook or copy the email.
A demo opens the menu and picks pages by itself until you click, tap or press a key.
